pages.title: Graviton Lens Array
pages.text: An array of gravitic lens elements that bend spacetime to focus gravitational waves, the way a glass lens bends light. Inside, the space seems to pinch toward the centre. Straight edges seen through its centre appear to bow outward, as if viewed through a thick drop of water.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Gravitational lensing is real: massive objects bend light. I set gravitic lens elements into event horizon casing over a hyperframe, and the array focused gravitational waves to a point.
Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Singularity Physics.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Eye of the Event Horizon, Vacuum Fluctuation Harvester.
